from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFinancialDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """One document's financial disclosure data that may contain the target company's information."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for this document in the collection")
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this financial report belongs to")
    company_security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company, if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    is_target_company: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document belongs to the target company mentioned in the task")
    usage_rights_assets: float | None = Field(description="The usage rights assets value if disclosed in this report")
    usage_rights_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit for the assets value, e.g., '元'")
    asset_balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance reported, e.g., '期末余额', '期初余额'")
    asset_balance_value: float | None = Field(description="The specific balance amount reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_financial_disclosures: list[DocumentFinancialDisclosure]
